cutter.name: Cutter
cutter.text: Solves problems with violence or coercion: muscle, collector, killer, bone-breaker. Where subtle methods fail, swift brutal action or a threat works.
cutter.xpTrigger: Gain xp when you address a challenge with violence or coercion.
list: Who is most afraid of me?
Who is the most dangerous here?
What are they about to do?
How can I get them to [X]?

battleborn.name: Battleborn
battleborn.text: Special armor: reduce harm from a fight by 1, or push yourself in combat for free.

bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
bodyguard.text: +1d to resist when you protect a teammate; +1 effect when sizing up threats.

ghost-fighter.name: Ghost Fighter
ghost-fighter.text: Imbue your hands, weapons or tools with arcane energy: potency against the supernatural, and you can grab ghosts.

leader.name: Leader
leader.text: Your gang fights on your command until they take level 4 harm; +1 effect and 1 armor box.

mule.name: Mule
mule.text: Higher load limits: light 5, normal 7, heavy 8.

not-to-be-trifled-with.name: Not to Be Trifled With
not-to-be-trifled-with.text: Push yourself for a feat of physical force at the edge of human capability, or to engage a small gang on equal footing.

savage.name: Savage
savage.text: +1d when you Command a creature that is already frightened.

vigorous.name: Vigorous
vigorous.text: The first healing clock segment is permanently filled; +1d to healing treatment rolls.

fine-small-weapon.name: Fine Small Weapon
fine-small-weapon.text: A superbly made one-handed melee weapon.

fine-heavy-weapon.name: Fine Heavy Weapon
fine-heavy-weapon.text: A two-handed weapon: potency where reach and striking power matter.

scary-weapon-or-tool.name: Scary Weapon or Tool
scary-weapon-or-tool.text: Improves the effect of intimidation, but not of harm.

essence-of-rage.name: Essence of Rage
essence-of-rage.text: A dose: strength and pain tolerance rise, but you lose control for minutes (two consequences).

marlane.name: Marlane
marlane.text: Perhaps a familiar from the dockside arena, or a boxing trainer.

chael.name: Chael
chael.text: Perhaps a member of your former gang, or an independent hired gun.

mercy.name: Mercy
mercy.text: Perhaps a mercenary or a deadly adventurer.

grace.name: Grace
grace.text: Perhaps a former partner in robbery, or a rival.

sawtooth.name: Sawtooth
sawtooth.text: Perhaps an acquaintance from the war years, or the butcher who ruined your health.
